active_work_package.title: Platform repository skeleton from the P0.2 design
active_work_package.objective: Create the place every later package lands, shaped so the modular monolith boundaries are tested rather than intended: the workspace and layout, the module registry, the seven dependency rules generated from it, the migration lint, the boundary test suite that proves both fire, the charter, these records and their schemas, and the CI skeleton. It implements no epic and creates no domain table.

stop_reason: An independent peer review of this branch returned REVISION_REQUIRED with four blockers, and all four are addressed here. F1 and F2: the migration lint failed OPEN, passing double-quoted identifiers, unqualified names, plural domain words and whole nested directories, which defeated four of the design's negative controls with ordinary legal SQL. F3: the gates and authority blocks were unconstrained, so the review erased every gate and forged three grants and still got exit 0. F4: four rule loosenings left the boundary suite fully green. F5 and F6 are fixed too: the checkpoint recorded an output that did not reproduce at the commit it named, and the non-coverage list omitted six real gaps. WP-001 stays at ENGINEERING_READY. The reviewer, not the implementer, decides whether the revision closes the findings, and no re-review of this head has happened. The primary action is still NS-001, because negative control 6 remains unobservable until a human records branch protection.
known_divergence: The boundary rules here are the PROPOSAL of a design at IN_REVIEW that depends on five ADRs, all DRAFT_REQUIRED; if ADR-001 narrows or widens the seven rules, the registry and the generator change with it and the suite is re-run. Two lessons from the review are recorded rather than smoothed over. First, the suite was green while four rules were unenforced, which is why scripts/mutation-check.mjs is now a required check: a suite that passes whether or not the rule works cannot tell you which it is. Second, two of those mutations survived even after fixtures were added, because a fixture carrying two violations of one rule proves neither; the migration controls now assert on the message, not the rule name. Declared non-coverage grew from seven items to twelve as a result, and the growth is the point: the earlier list was honest in tone and incomplete in fact. One earlier claim was affirmatively wrong and is withdrawn, not softened: the migration lint was described as conservative by design when it was the opposite.
